readingText.content:
A surprise party

My friend Luca’s birthday is on June 16th, just before school finishes for the summer. Luca never celebrates his birthday, so my friends and I decided to plan a surprise birthday party for him.

The party was last Sunday, in the afternoon. It was at my friend Marco’s house. I took some cool computer games to the party – Luca loves playing computer games. Lucy and Ben took drinks – some orange juice and fizzy drinks. Some other friends took some nice snacks to eat. Marco’s mum made the birthday cake and his dad cooked some burgers.

We were all ready for Luca to arrive at Marco’s house at half past five. How exciting! All of us sat under the table. We were all quiet. We wanted to give Luca a surprise! We waited and waited and waited for Luca. It was six o’clock. Where was he?

I called Luca. ‘‘Where are you?’’ I asked. ‘‘I’m at home, why?’’ he answered. Oh, no! There was a problem. No one told Luca to come to Marco’s house on Sunday afternoon. So, there wasn’t a surprise party, after all!
